title: Chapter 12: Wheel of Misfortune
html:
Because of her forensic studies, Gao Ru Xue was far more accustomed to cadavers than the average person. She was not especially social, and she often found the quiet of the lab easier to deal with than crowded social situations.

“Our Haunted House uses a special makeup technique. Combined with the atmosphere inside the attraction, it creates that illusion.” There was no reasonable way for Chen Ge to explain Mortician’s Makeup or Black Friday, so he kept his answer vague and quickly changed the subject. “If that’s everything, I need to get back to work. Thank you for visiting us today.”

After saying goodbye to the two students, Chen Ge asked Xu Wan to reset the props in the Minghun scenario while he returned to the control room alone.

Only Chen Ge knew what had really happened to He San: the creature in the mirror had not left. It was still hiding somewhere inside the Haunted House.

If I leave it alone, it’ll only cause more trouble later.This was Chen Ge’s first experience dealing with the aftermath of a Nightmare Mission, and he had not expected the consequences to be so complicated. After switching off the background music, he pulled up the surveillance footage from the minutes after He San entered the West House. Comparing several camera angles, he soon noticed something strange.

At 9:24:11, He San ran into the West House like a headless chicken.

At 9:24:14, the moment his gaze landed on the bronze mirror, something strange happened. The frantic He San abruptly became unnaturally calm and stood motionless before the glass. If not for the timecode continuing to tick forward, Chen Ge might have thought the video had frozen.

At 9:24:17, He San suddenly raised his left hand and began walking slowly toward the mirror. It looked as though someone—or something—were pulling him forward.

At 9:24:20, Xu Wan ran into the room in her wedding dress. By then, He San’s upper body was almost touching the mirror. The camera caught a brief flash inside the glass, and a moment later He San collapsed.

Did Xiao Wan’s arrival interrupt the creature’s plan?Chen Ge replayed the ten-second sequence again and again. Too much had happened in those few moments. He rubbed his temples but could not think of a good solution.

Until I find a permanent solution, I guess the only thing I can do is cover every mirror in the Haunted House.Chen Ge returned to the Props Room, collected several pieces of black cloth, and headed back to the Minghun set.

“Boss, why are you here? Just leave the cleanup to me.” Xu Wan spotted him while gathering the paper mannequins and paper money and returning them to the coffin.

“I came to tell you something. For now, stop using any props or scares involving mirrors. And while you’re working, stay away from them whenever possible.” Carrying the black cloth, Chen Ge helped Xu Wan close the fake coffin.

Xu Wan was puzzled by Chen Ge’s instructions, but she did not ask questions. After repairing the props in the Main House, Chen Ge entered the West House alone.

The white lantern cast a weak glow across the room. Chen Ge stood where He San had fainted and stared at the bronze mirror.

“Someone lives inside the mirror? Could there really be another world behind it?” Chen Ge touched the cold glass and stared at his reflection for a long time. He could not say exactly why, but something felt wrong. When I handed He San that bottle of water earlier, he took it with his right hand, so he isn’t left-handed. But in the video he raised his left hand. Why would he suddenly use the opposite hand? Was the thing in the mirror controlling him?

Chen Ge placed his left hand on the mirror, which aligned perfectly with his mirrored right hand. After all, everything is inverted inside the mirror.

After covering the mirror with a black cloth, Chen Ge pulled out the black phone. This all started with the phone. If the creature appeared because of it, then the phone may also be the key to dealing with it.

He opened the Haunted House app and immediately noticed several changes to the interface. Both the Daily Visitor Number and Monthly Visitor Number had increased by two.

A Trial Mission had also appeared beneath the list of unlockable scenarios. When he tapped it, a message explained that completing the mission would unlock the corresponding scenario.

The game’s design seems fair enough. Complete a mission, earn a reward—the more difficult the mission, the better the reward. If I want to expand the Haunted House and deal with the thing in the mirror, I’ll have to keep completing these missions.

He could accept only one Daily Mission per day, so Chen Ge’s attention naturally shifted to the Trial Mission.

“Murder by Midnight—A dangerous psychiatric patient has moved into a dilapidated apartment building. Armed with scissors and a hammer, he is pacing outside your door.

“Mission Location: Ping An Apartments in the western countryside.

“Mission Requirement: Reach the mission location before 23:00 today. Identify the person responsible for the murder and remain there until dawn.

“Mission Hint: He hides among the crowd like a wolf among sheep. Beneath his harmless exterior lies a twisted heart.

“Do you wish to accept this mission? Warning: Trial Missions remain available for only twenty-four hours. If not accepted within that period, the scenario can never be unlocked.”

Chen Ge hesitated at first, but the final sentence convinced him to accept.

Whatever happens, happens. Things are finally improving at the Haunted House. I can’t pass up any chance to make it better.

After accepting the mission, he scrolled farther down. At some point, the Haunted Wheel of Misfortune had become active without him noticing. Curious, Chen Ge tapped it, and a line of text appeared.

“Life and death are decreed by fate; fortune and misfortune are separated by only a hair. Here you may find Spirit Fruits that extend your lifespan—or Baleful Specters overflowing with hatred!

“The Wheel activates after collecting a visitor’s scream for the first time. You have received one free spin for this initial activation. (A scream is collected when it exceeds seventy decibels. One hundred collected screams may be exchanged for one spin of the Wheel of Misfortune.)”

One hundred screams for one spin?Chen Ge frowned as he read the details. This wheel is awful on so many levels. It’s hard enough just to activate, and the result is random? If I end up with a Baleful Specter, won’t all that effort have been wasted?

Chen Ge stared at the box showing one spin remaining and felt an almost irresistible urge to press it. It was like seeing an unread notification on his phone; even if it was probably an advertisement, he still wanted to check.

I mean, what can possibly go wrong?Chen Ge told himself that, then lightly tapped the screen. The wheel began to spin.

As long as it’s not a Baleful Specter, I’m fine with anything!
